info.title: fshw
info.description: CLI for FsHotWatch — F# file watcher daemon

commands.name: check
commands.description: Run all checks. The fast inner loop — the tests are IMPACT-FILTERED, which is a latency optimization and not the basis for a merge decision (use `confirm` for that)

commands.name: confirm
commands.description:
Run the FULL suite and confirm `check` told the truth.
Any disagreement is a BUG:
failed here, not selected by check  → the selector MISSED a test
passed here, but check says failed  → a stale red, a flake, or a
test that only passes with company
Refuses a green verdict from anything less than the full suite (exit 3).

commands.name: dead-code
commands.description: Report unreachable symbols from entry points (TestPrune dead-code analysis over the daemon DB)

options.name: --entry
options.description: Entry-point name pattern (repeatable; replaces the defaults: *.main, *.Program.*, *.Routes.*, *.Scheduler.*) (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_ENTRY)

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include symbols from test files in the report (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_INCLUDE_TESTS)

commands.name: scan
commands.description:
Scan for file changes
rerun <plugin-name> Force a plugin to re-run, clearing its cached state

commands.name: test-rerun
commands.description: Rerun tests with an xUnit v3 --filter-class / --filter-trait slice

options.name: --filter-class
options.description: Pass --filter-class <pattern> to the underlying test runner (xUnit v3) (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_FILTER_CLASS)

options.name: --filter-trait
options.description: Pass --filter-trait <name=value> to the underlying test runner (xUnit v3) (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_FILTER_TRAIT)

options.name: --project
options.description: Limit the rerun to this test project (repeatable; matches the project name in your test config). Without it the filter is fanned out across EVERY configured test project, so a class living in one of them makes all the others report zero matches. (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_PROJECT)

options.name: --wait-sec
options.description: Seconds to wait for an in-flight background test run to release the slot before reporting busy (default 600). Raise it above a long tests.beforeRun chain so an explicit rerun isn't defeated. (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_WAIT_SEC)

commands.name: verdict
commands.description: Report the last check's verdict and whether it still applies to the current tree (reads .fshw/verdict.json; never contacts the daemon)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable on-disk task result cache (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_NO_CACHE)

options.name: --no-warn-fail
options.description: Treat warnings as non-fatal (errors still fail) (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_NO_WARN_FAIL)

options.name: --agent
options.description: Agent-friendly parseable output with next-step hint (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_AGENT)
